title: Learning Rhetorical Structure Theory-based descriptions of observed behaviour
reasoning: The paper utilizes deontic logic and 'ideality principles' to formalize agent behavior understanding. While these are concepts from normative ethics (specifically deontology), the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, moral systems, or societal values, nor does it apply these to Large Language Models (LLMs). Its focus is on symbolic AI and discourse theory for agent explainability.
